question: In evidence.zip, use the d99-- member. Submit true exactly when at least three exported symbol names start with _pg_lib_. Submit lowercase true or false.
oracle_cmd: [ $(python3 -c "import lief, sys; b = lief.parse('pg_macho.dylib'); n = [s.name for s in b.exported_symbols]; sys.stdout.write(''.join(x + chr(10) for x in n)); sys.stdout.flush()" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^_pg_lib_') -ge 3 ] && echo true || echo false
